apps/ios/Player/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon..prompt:
Visual language: match the attached concept art exactly in rendering quality, palette and mood — premium cinematic dark-fantasy game art, high-detail painterly digital painting like AAA fantasy RPG key art; deep night-blue and charcoal shadows, warm amber lantern and candle light, burnished antique gold metalwork, accents of luminous teal-cyan magic and ember red. Use the attached images only as a style reference: do not copy their layout, characters, panels or any text.

Create A square 1:1 app icon artwork for iPhone and Android, full bleed: the painting fills the whole square, no rounded corners, no border, no frame, no transparency. One single bold subject, centred, kept inside the central 60 percent of the square so it survives circular and rounded masks; the rest is a calm deep night-blue background with a soft vignette. Strong silhouette and contrast so it still reads at 60 pixels wide; no small details at the edges. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, runes that read as letters, logos, signatures or watermarks.
The subject, for the players' app: a single large twenty-sided die carved from dark obsidian with burnished antique gold edges, its upper face glowing with luminous teal-cyan light, resting in an open leather-gloved palm seen from slightly above, warm amber rim light. It must sit beside the attached gold emblem as one family: the same burnished gold, the same painterly finish.
